summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing a monthly and quarterly delivery update for June and Q2 2026, reporting 40,597 vehicles delivered in June (up 62.9% YoY) and 107,658 in Q2 (up 49.4% YoY). This is a routine operational update typical for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, tender, or restructuring activity is mentioned. The filing simply discloses sales volumes and cumulative deliveries reaching 1,188,715 as of June 30, 2026. No deal terms or corporate actions are present; it is a standard business update with no event-driven implications.
